notes.title: KING & CONCERTS UPDATE
notes.notes:
[p][b]This is our biggest update yet, celebrating the game's anniversary! We've added 4 new tavern levels and new mechanics![/b][/p][p][/p][h2]🎶Musicians and Concerts[/h2][p]What's a tavern without bards? Hire musicians and organize concerts in your tavern. Let your patrons dance!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/7df8a49461598fe399c80d6489d37f8edba02a8d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]👑Long Live the King! [/h2][p]The King himself may visit your tavern. And if you want to speed up your fairies, use the flowers they love so much.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/27bccf88237e9d2760b1ab5bda801572bd9daf88.gif"][/img][/p][p]
---[/p][h3]Improvements:[/h3][p]🧚‍♀️ A fairy concierge will take care of the hotel[/p][p]🏨 The hotel can be closed, and the hall can be decorated[/p][p]🪓 Axe upgrades will make chopping wood easier[/p][p]🛠️New decorations like railings and small stairs will allow you to beautifully partition tables[/p][p]👁️‍🗨️ A spotter will notify you of an approaching thief[/p][p]💰 The loan size increases with your reputation level[/p][p]🖼️ Lots of new decorations[/p][p]🏆Extended level progression with rewards if you choose to play after completing the main storyline[/p][p]---[/p][h3]Fixes:[/h3][p]🤔 Sometimes patrons would stand up but not leave[/p][p]🧼 Wiping stains is no longer laggy, and there are more types of stains[/p][p]🎵 Sometimes the music wouldn't start playing immediately when the game launched[/p][p]🧚‍♀️ Sometimes the fairies would forget about the soup[/p][p]🌫️ Less windy and foggy weather, reduced lightning brightness, quieter wind[/p][p]🌧️ Rain and fog should not appear inside the building[/p][p]💬 Sometimes it was possible to get stuck in a dialogue by clicking on characters too quickly[/p][p]📌Interactive decor is now marked with a special icon in the inventory and shop[/p][p]✉️ The letter is removed after catching the goblin[/p][p]🍔 Characters now hold food better[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Return to the tavern and build the Best Tavern Ever!

notes.title: Patch | Tavern Manager Simulator v1.4.6
notes.notes:
We have made several changes to the game to improve performance and raise the average FPS.

If you encounter any new problems, please send information about the bug with its description. This can be done in the game by clicking on the button "Found a bug? Let us know!"

notes.title: Patch | Tavern Manager Simulator v1.4.5
notes.notes:
Few fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed situations where the freezer stopped working
[*] Fixed riders not being able to mount a horse
[*] Fixed situations where visitors were incorrectly facing the counter-table
[*] Horses should not disappear when loading the game
[*] Fixed disappearing environmental objects (flag, waterfall, fence)
[*] Fixed non-working decoration points
[*] Additional minor visual improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Hotel Patch | Tavern Manager Simulator v1.4.3
notes.notes:
Fixes in the hotel:
[list]
[*] We tried to fix all the cases you sent us about jammed doors and missing keys in the hotel. Thanks for your messages.
[*] It is now easier to jump over railings and into windows
[*] Death bones no longer threaten the construction site
[*] More clear tips on what to do when cleaning and in which room there is dirt
[*] You can put your favorite cactus on the reception desk. We didn't think you loved them so much
[*] Fed and hungry horses are counted even when the tavern is closed
[/list]

notes.title: Big Update: Hotel is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]🏨 UPDATE: HOTEL 🏨[/h1]
We've been preparing for this moment for a long time and finally added a BIG construction site! Now your guests have a place to relax after a delicious lunch - meet the HOTEL! You will have to greet guests, clean the rooms and keep things cozy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/3043a466632f32d0fc19dd00cb3a7378bf2c4dcb.gif[/img]

But first, the hotel needs to be built, and a team of highly skilled goblins will help you with this. Don't worry - they will NOT steal your sausage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/82beb75725d0373313b560b2d54563aa732dac9c.gif[/img]

The hotel becomes available from level 11.

[h3] Other Important Improvements[/h3]
💧 [b]Water Supply Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] New upgrades for the well and water supply system.
[*] Ability to store water and collect it in the new water pump.
[*] Water reserves in the kitchen to spend less time refilling it.
[/list]
💰 [b]Price Controller[/b]
Now you can adjust the prices of dishes!
More visitors or a calm atmosphere? Choose the balance that suits you.

🆘 [b]New button "Help, item stuck!"[/b]
If an item has fallen through the floor or is stuck after an upgrade, solve the problem right in the pause menu.

🧚 [b]Flexible customization of fairy waitresses[/b]
[list]
[*] Determine which halls they work in.
[*] Choose whether they will do cleaning.
[*] Set their priorities so that the work is more efficient!
[/list]
✅ [b]Fixes and minor improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Visitors no longer get stuck near the toilet.
[*] Fairies now have cute wings and work magic while working. 
[*] In the VIP hall, the screens have become lower - orders are now visible.
[*] NPC walking animations play correctly even if you slightly... hit them.
[/list]

[h2]The update is now available! Thank you for playing! ❤️[/h2]

If you want to support us, then add our next game to your wishlist - a co-op anime shop simulator

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393280/Anime_Shop_Simulator/

or buy a DLC with unique tavern signs

notes.title: Tavern Manager Simulator v.1.0.9_1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Some users had incorrect counters (showed negative values) during the last update. We fixed this problem.

If you still have the problem after installing this patch, try restarting the game. If the problem persists, please send a bug report.

notes.title: Tavern Manager Simulator v.1.0.8 Patch Note
notes.notes:
More fixes and improvements:
- more stable work of fairies
- more stable work of quests
- fixed bug with quest for washing
- minor performance improvements

notes.title: Tavern Manager Simulator v.1.0.6 Fairies Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed most common problems with the fairies. 

[b]Fairies:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed freezing if you wash a stain while a fairy is flying towards it
[*] fixed that worker fairies do not fly to their stations after restarting the game

notes.title: Tavern Manager Simulator v.1.0.5 Signs Update
notes.notes:
We have read your reports about missing cats, rabbits and flowers. Well, they're back. 

We decided to update signs one last time. Our artist has added his own style❤️  We hope you will like it. 
Perhaps in the future, we will add even more new signs.

P.S. We continue to work on fixing fairies. There should be an update early next week.

notes.title: Tavern Manager Simulator v.1.0.4 Art Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Innkeepers!

Thank you for your feedback! We have listened to your concerns and removed the placeholder materials created using AI. They have now been replaced.

Additionally, we’ve refreshed the icons on the signboards, making them more atmospheric. Please note that your signboards in the game will be automatically updated as well.

We hope you enjoy this update!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2756770/Tavern_Manager_Simulator/

[*] A new type of visitor: a drunkard.
